_comment: Examples only; do not store real secrets here.

lmstudio.notes: Runner loads/unloads the model with lms.

openrouter.notes: Use OpenCode /connect -> OpenRouter once; pass OpenRouter model ID to --model.

gpt2giga_local_proxy.notes: gpt2giga defaults to http://localhost:8090; use /v1 for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Set the actual model ID and client API key configuration from your installation.

generic_openai_compatible.notes: The key itself stays in the environment and is never written to opencode.json.
